Name: No Forced Cutscene
Author: Dreamery
Description: Fix forced cutscene in Ridgeside Village in Coop, now each player triggers its own cutscene

Manifest.Name: No Forced Cutscenes
Manifest.Description: In co-op, stops Ridgeside Village story cutscenes started by another player from teleporting you into them. Instead, the cutscene is saved and plays just for you the next time you go to that place. Each player who wants this needs it installed.
Manifest.Author: Daniel
